item.tib: dbal chen drag po rngam pa'i thugs rgyud las las mkhan brgya rtsa'i zlog pa byad ma 'bum sgrol
item.coloph: zlog chung byad ma 'bum zlog zhes bya ba/ slob dpon chen po'i thugs bcud/ phyi rabs gshen gyi spyod yul/ dam nyams log can la ma shor cig sa ma ya/ rgya rgya rgya/ stang chen dmu tsa gyer med kyi (kyis/)phyi rabs las ldan gshen la brgyud pa dge legs 'phel//
